comment: The filter's cutoff CV works out at almost exactly 1V per octave by coincidence rather than by design: TapestryExpander.cpp:160 adds a tenth of the voltage to a knob that dsp/tapestry-effects.h:88-92 maps logarithmically from 20Hz to 20kHz, and a thousandfold range over a tenth of the travel is a factor of 1.995. It is not declared as tracking and it shifts with the sample rate, since the top of the range is held to 45% of it.
